wholePhysicalScope: Native way 402954433 fixes the place and the surviving outer alignment. The circa-1888 archival plan sets the internal volume relationships. Its central entrance is registered approximately to the mapped east-northeast curtain using the compass labels in the 1890 sketch.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the historic court arrangement, low enclosure, open passage, gatehouse, chapel and secondary ranges. Wall coping and window trim simplify with distance.
limitations: Circa 1890 reconstruction from the two dated archival records. Museum-era buildings and grounds are outside this time slice.
The historic gate orientation and the fit of the archive plan inside the mapped enclosure are approximate. Roof and wall heights and finishes are estimated from the drawings.
Original terrain elevations are retained. Individual historic foundation heights and any lost landscaping are approximate.
